# fct_portal_events

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.fct_portal_events` · dbt area: `portal`

Fact table where each row is a unique event on the Advisor Portal (such as a page view or button click). While all events are tracked upstream, only a small portion of them are modeled in dbt and show here. Use Amplitude instead for that. Sourced from Segment.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `event_id` | Primary Key. Unique ID assigned to each event. Created by Segment. >> SOURCE - Segment data_tests: - unique - not_null |
| `anonymous_id` | Foreign Key. Segment's default user identifier that tracks visitors before authentication. >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `blended_user_id` | Foreign Key. The identifier used for sessionization - uses anonymous_id when user_id is 0, otherwise uses user_id. >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `context_user_ip_address` | The user's IP Address. >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `event_at` | Timestamp of when the event occurred. >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `event_metadata` | Additional descriptive information related to the event. Stored in a JSON object. >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `event_name` | The name of the event, generally named using the convention of {page}__{feature}__{action}. >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `following_page_path` | The destination path of the event's URL, such as '/clients', from the event AFTER the current one. Often, it will be the same as the event's current 'page_path'. >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `page_path` | The destination path of the event's URL, such as '/partners/hotels'. >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `page_query_string` | The query string (after the '?') in the event's URL. >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `page_subdomain` | The subdomain of the URL. Examples include advisor or trips. >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `page_title` | The title of the event's page; comes from the <title> in the HTML. >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `page_url` | The path + query string of event's URL. >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `page_view_id` | Foreign Key. Unique ID assigned to each page view using the page sequence, user_id, and page path. >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `previous_page_path` | The destination path of the event's URL, such as '/bookings', from the event BEFORE the current one. Often, it will be the same as the event's current 'page_path'. >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `user_id` | Foreign Key. The 'User ID' in the Portal database. >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `session_id` | Foreign Key. Unique ID assigned to each session using the session sequence and user_id. >> SOURCE - Segment |
